# AMOS Pac.Pic. fixtures

`Castle_AMOS.Abk` is a 320×200, four-plane `Pac.Pic.` bank from “Castle AMOS”,
one of the demo games bundled with AMOS. It contains the full 90-byte screen
header, a 16-colour `$0RGB` palette, and PICDATA, RLEDATA, and POINTS streams.

`Castle_AMOS.png` is the supplied indexed rendering control. Every expanded
RGB pixel matches Vexter's decoded raster exactly. See the repository
[`THIRD_PARTY.md`](../../../THIRD_PARTY.md) for provenance and redistribution
cautions.
